meta.scope: Japan batch 4 — Further depth: METI industrial production & related surveys (already partially in batch 3 but expanded notes), additional health & education series, Japan–EU EPA as second FTA node, prefectural contrast (Okinawa Statistical Yearbook / peripheral prefecture example), and supporting series. Completes a deep Japan core under the locked definition so that return visits are unnecessary.
meta.strategy_note: User requested full-picture depth on Japan (financial, disaster, immigration uniqueness already covered in batch 3; this batch fills industrial, trade detail, health, education, additional FTA, and prefectural contrast). Batches of ~10–12 maintained.

candidates.title: Census of Manufactures (工業統計調査) / Economic Census for Business Activity (manufacturing component)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) in coordination with Statistics Bureau
candidates.description: Periodic structural census of manufacturing establishments providing detailed data on number of establishments, employees, shipments, value added, and related indicators by industry and size. Historically the Census of Manufactures; now integrated into the broader Economic Census for Business Activity framework while retaining manufacturing-specific depth.
candidates.notes: Fundamental structural statistics for the manufacturing sector. Supplies benchmarks for the monthly Current Survey of Production and for national-accounts production estimates. Results are used for industrial policy, SME analysis, and regional economic structure studies. Complements the Economic Census node from batch 1.

candidates.title: Vital Statistics (人口動態統計)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW)
candidates.description: Annual (with monthly provisional) statistics on live births, deaths, marriages, divorces, foetal deaths and related rates. Includes cause-of-death data, age-specific rates, total fertility rate, and prefectural breakdowns. Fundamental demographic statistics derived from the family-register system.
candidates.notes: Core input into Population Estimates and long-term demographic projections. Total fertility rate and cause-of-death series are heavily cited in policy debates on ageing and population decline. Prefectural differentials highlight regional contrasts (e.g., lower fertility and different mortality patterns in peripheral prefectures).

candidates.title: National Health and Nutrition Survey (国民健康・栄養調査)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW)
candidates.description: Annual (with periodic detailed reporting) survey of nutritional intake, physical measurements, blood pressure, lifestyle (smoking, alcohol, exercise), and related health indicators of the Japanese population. Provides the evidence base for health promotion and dietary guidelines.
candidates.notes: Long-running health monitoring series. Results on obesity, nutrient intake, and lifestyle risk factors are cited in Health Japan 21 plans and in international comparisons. Complements vital statistics and social-security data for a fuller picture of population health under rapid ageing.

candidates.title: School Basic Survey (学校基本調査)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
candidates.description: Annual census-style survey of all schools (kindergarten through tertiary, including specialised and correspondence courses). Covers number of schools, students, teachers, entrants, graduates, advancement rates, and related indicators, with prefectural and detailed breakdowns.
candidates.notes: Fundamental education statistics. Provides the official counts of enrolment, advancement to higher education, and teacher numbers. Continuously used for education-policy planning, human-capital analysis, and demographic projections of the school-age population. Prefectural tables allow contrast between urban centres (Tokyo, Osaka) and peripheral prefectures.

candidates.title: Japan–EU Economic Partnership Agreement (Japan–EU EPA)
candidates.publisher: Government of Japan and European Union
candidates.description: Bilateral economic partnership agreement that entered into force in February 2019. Eliminates or reduces tariffs on the vast majority of goods trade, liberalises services and investment, and includes provisions on regulatory cooperation, sustainable development and other areas. One of Japan’s largest bilateral trade agreements by partner economic weight.
referenced_by: Official Japanese and EU economic-impact assessments and CGE studies
MOF Trade Statistics commentary on EU partner shares and post-EPA trade growth
METI and Cabinet Office trade-policy documents
RIETI and academic analyses that treat the EPA as a baseline or counterfactual
Subsequent EPA/FTA negotiation impact studies that use Japan–EU results as a comparator
candidates.notes: Static bilateral instrument that meets the expanded node definition through recurring citation in official impact analyses, trade statistics, and policy documents. Complements the CPTPP node; together they illustrate Japan’s multi-track trade-agreement strategy. Economic-effect quantifications are published and updated in policy contexts, satisfying the recurring-citation test.

candidates.title: Okinawa Prefectural Statistical Yearbook (沖縄県統計年鑑)
candidates.description: Annual comprehensive statistical yearbook for Okinawa Prefecture covering population, economy, social conditions, education, health, base-related statistics, and other domains. Serves as the primary local statistical reference for Japan’s southernmost and socio-economically distinctive prefecture.
candidates.notes: Prefectural-contrast node. Okinawa exhibits distinctive demographic, economic (tourism, bases, lower income levels) and historical patterns relative to mainland prefectures and Tokyo. The yearbook provides local production, income, employment, education and social indicators that allow systematic comparison with national and Tokyo series. Useful for testing hierarchy homogeneity across Japan’s most peripheral major prefecture.

candidates.title: Vital Statistics — detailed cause-of-death and fertility series (within MHLW Vital Statistics)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW)
candidates.description: Detailed annual tabulations within the Vital Statistics system covering age- and cause-specific death rates, leading causes of death, total fertility rate by birth order and maternal age, and prefectural differentials. Extends the basic vital-statistics node with the analytical depth required for health and demographic policy.
candidates.notes: Deepens the vital-statistics coverage. Cause-of-death and fertility detail are central to Japan’s policy response to super-ageing and ultra-low fertility. Prefectural tables support the contrast analysis (Tokyo vs peripheral prefectures such as Okinawa or Tohoku).

candidates.title: Statistical Abstract of Education, Science and Culture / 文部科学統計要覧
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
candidates.description: Annual statistical abstract compiling key education indicators (schools, enrolment, teachers, advancement rates, expenditure) together with science, culture and sports statistics. Complements the School Basic Survey with a broader policy-oriented presentation.
candidates.notes: Authoritative annual compendium for the education and science policy community. Draws heavily on the School Basic Survey and related MEXT surveys. Used for international comparisons (OECD) and for domestic human-capital and regional-education analysis.

candidates.title: National Health and Nutrition Survey (国民健康・栄養調査)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW)
candidates.description: Annual survey of dietary intake, nutritional status, physical measurements, blood pressure, blood chemistry, and lifestyle factors (smoking, alcohol, physical activity). Provides the evidence base for national health promotion plans (Health Japan 21) and dietary reference intakes.
candidates.notes: Long-running population health monitoring series. Results on obesity, salt intake, vegetable consumption, and lifestyle risks are cited in health policy and in international comparisons. Complements vital statistics and social-security data for a full picture of health under rapid population ageing.

candidates.title: Petroleum Statistics / Energy-related Current Statistics (石油統計等)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
candidates.description: Monthly statistics on production, imports, inventories and consumption of petroleum and related energy products. Part of METI’s suite of energy and industrial current statistics that feed into energy-balance and national-accounts energy estimates.
candidates.notes: Important for energy-security and price-pass-through analysis. Complements the CGPI energy components and the broader industrial-production indices. Frequently referenced when discussing Japan’s import dependence and the impact of global energy shocks.
